# Third-party notices

Unmodified license and notice files from the dependencies pinned in Cargo.lock. This includes platform-specific packages and is not a claim that every listed package is linked into every binary. LLVM-MinGW-LICENSE.TXT covers the bundled LLVM runtime distribution. No separate license for the Kartoteka project code has been assigned.

Collected files: 338. Packages whose top-level source directory did not contain a matching notice filename: clipboard-win 5.4.3, codespan-reporting 0.11.1, ecolor 0.31.1, eframe 0.31.1, egui 0.31.1, egui-wgpu 0.31.1, egui-winit 0.31.1, egui_extras 0.31.1, egui_glow 0.31.1, emath 0.31.1, enum-map 2.7.3, enum-map-derive 0.17.0, epaint 0.31.1, epaint_default_fonts 0.31.1, gl_generator 0.14.0, gpu-alloc 0.6.2, gpu-alloc-types 0.3.1, gpu-descriptor 0.3.2, gpu-descriptor-types 0.2.0, hexf-parse 0.2.1, khronos_api 3.1.0, naga 24.0.0, profiling 1.0.18, spirv 0.3.0+sdk-1.3.268.0, winapi-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu 0.4.0. Refer to the published crate source for its full terms.

Additional upstream notices: egui0.31.1 MIT/Apache from https://github.com/emilk/egui/tree/0.31.1 ; bundled font notices from epaint_default_fonts0.31.1; Winpthreads COPYING from https://github.com/mingw-w64/mingw-w64/tree/master/mingw-w64-libraries/winpthreads. Original upstream texts are preserved.
